Flintts Mints' unique botanical blend contains an extract from the Spilanthes flower, which is native to the Amazon.  Higher F-strength means more mouth-watering and a stronger sparkle.

Mellow sparkle and mouth watering effect.
Black cherry has an earthy sweetness and is also a little bit tart. 
Early Autumn vibes.
 
 
The mints are vegan, non-GMO and sugar free. There is no cannabis in this product.
